description: Spring Boot best practices.
Use Maven (`pom.xml`) or Gradle (`build.gradle`); Spring Boot starters. Organize by feature/domain. Always use constructor-based injection for required dependencies; dependency fields `private final`. Use component stereotypes appropriately.
